  CITY COUNCIL

Council beginning at 6:00 PM on December 9, 2025 in the City Council Chambers, Norwalk City Hall, 12700
Norwalk Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

  (Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the items listed. Please fill out a speaker card and

   City Council Agenda Report
  December 9, 2025

TO:  Honorable City Council

FROM:  Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager

BY:  Theresa Devoy, City Clerk

SUBJECT: CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

Background:

Annually, City Council selects one of its members to serve as Mayor and one to serve as Vice
Mayor. Following is the procedure for reorganization:

The City Clerk will declare that the next item of business shall be the selection of a Mayor and a
Vice Mayor for the upcoming year.

The City Clerk declares that nominations are in order for the office of Mayor. The City Clerk
accepts nominations; a second to the nomination is not necessary. If there are no further
nominations, the City Clerk will close the nominations and take a roll call vote. If more than one
nomination, a vote will be taken in the order of the nomination. Following the vote(s), the City
Clerk declares the Mayor elected.

Following the election of the Mayor, the same procedure will be followed to elect a new Vice
Mayor for the upcoming year.
